subject: Post-call executive recap — pilot success criteria & procurement path
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@auroramed.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T15:02:00Z
Subject: Post-call executive recap — pilot success criteria & procurement path

Oliver — thanks for the time today. Quick recap for your leadership and our teams so we have alignment going into the pilot planning session:

Top pain points you confirmed
- Production inference latency spikes during peak scheduling windows (~300–400ms target now, spikes to 1.2s)
- Per‑session inferencing cost is pushing limits on your clinician-facing workflows
- Model governance: need strict audit logs + data residency in us-east region

Outcome goals for the pilot (mutually agreed)
- Reduce median latency to <= 250ms for 90% of requests within pilot environment
- Demonstrate a 40% reduction in per-token inference cost compared to current hosted endpoint
- Verify audit log completeness + integrate with AuroraMed SIEM for 30 days of pilot traffic

Procurement & path to commercial
- Pilot: 6 weeks, dedicated capacity (staging) with 3rd week go/no-go checkpoint with your exec sponsor
- Procurement: AuroraMed to issue PO for pilot once security sign-off completed; production contract and SOW to follow after pilot acceptance
- Security evidence: we will provide SOC 2 summary + network design (attached) and a short runbook for audit ingestion

Escalation items we flagged
- If audit telemetry is not ingestible into your SIEM within 10 business days we escalate to solutions engineering + your infra lead
- Pricing exceptions: we can surface a pilot credit but any long-term discounting requires procurement approval from your finance lead

Immediate next steps (owner / ETA)
- Sean: share SOC 2 summary + pilot measurement template (attached) — sent now
- Marissa: schedule pilot kick-off and SOW draft by Fri 5/22 — owner: marissa.cole@redwood.com
- Oliver: confirm legal/ procurement contact and target PO timeline (reply requested by 5/24)

If this matches what you heard, I’ll push the kick-off invite and loop in our solutions engineer for a walkthrough of the staging topology.

Thanks again — Sean

--
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0138
Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): SOC2-summary.pdf (pdf) — 2 pages, high-level; pilot-measurements-template.xlsx (xlsx) — measurement checklist

1) Our exec sponsor (CFO) wants clarity on potential uplift in month 1 if we need burst capacity — can you give us a worst-case monthly cost estimate for a 2x peak burst during pilot?
2) I will introduce you to our procurement lead (procurement@auroramed.com) and our security architect (maria.velasquez@auroramed.com). Please send the SOC2 and a brief network diagram to Maria.

I’ll aim to have procurement contact in the thread by Monday.

—Oliver

Oliver — looping in procurement and security items so we can keep timelines tight. Quick notes on your asks: 

- Burst cost estimate: we’ll run a short capacity model and provide a worst-case delta for a 2x burst (estimating GPU minutes + infra) by EOD 5/21; preliminary guess is ~15–25% uplift on pilot month but we will confirm.
- Security evidence: Maria — attaching SOC2-summary and a one‑page network/topology. If you prefer, we can do a 30‑minute walkthrough with our infra engineer to validate ingestion into AuroraMed SIEM.
- Pilot acceptance criteria: propose we formalize the 3 acceptance gates in the SOW (latency SLA check, cost target, audit log ingestion). Happy to bake these into the SOW draft.

Action owners: 
- Marissa: SOW draft + acceptance gates — deliver 5/22
- Sean: cost/burst delta and pilot runbook — deliver 5/21 EOD
- Kimberly: commercial touchpoint and escalation path — she will own any deviation requests after the pilot

Thanks — Marissa

Sean
